==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I appear inside a space station. It is an academy for multiverse warriors. I am late for a lecture.

In the lecture hall, I discover that I am the professor. Suddenly, I become aware of my memories as a commander in the ongoing war of Light and Chaos. I tell the students about what it is like to lead an army of your own multiverse variants.

I recall a battle involving robotic agents of chaos that can phase through walls. The battle is tough and takes place in a sunny courtyard the size of a football field. I wake up in the middle of my recollection.
